versions.content: Description of I/O Identifiers Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the description of I/O Identifiers for Diagnostic Services. Rationale: The definition of I/O Identifiers is a central part of the configuration of the AUTOSAR diagnostic stack. Use Case: The user wants to define an I/O Identifier. This typically extends to the modeling of the Diagnostic Data Identifier. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: More information can be found in the specification of the AUTOSAR Diagnostic Communication Manager [3].
